3d13c0770e7dde42.title: New York City approves ban on horse-drawn carriages. Phase-out set for 2028.
3d13c0770e7dde42.summary: A New York tradition more than a century old is ending. The New York City Council on Oct. 22 voted to ban horse-drawn carriages , winding down a historic tradition that s popular among tourists and fiercely opposed by animal rights groups. In a majority vote, the 51-member council approved a ban prohibiting new carriage licenses and the ending the operation of horse carriages by June 2028.
